--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Norlin Quad is the historic heart of CU Boulder, surrounded by Tuscan-inspired sandstone buildings. The Dalton Trumbo Fountain and Elaura Jaquette memorial plaque are both located here. A popular outdoor gathering and free speech space.
